item.title: Environment and hay quality
item.description: SEDALIA, Mo. – Extreme cold weather has an enormous impact on animal energy demands. Wet weather also increases energy requirements for livestock. To illustrate these points, I’ve formulated some beef cow diets for varying temperatures, hair coat conditions, and hay quality.

item.title: Prairie Home readies for summer ball
item.description: Prairie Home Recreational Associations sing-up for the upcoming baseball, softball, and T-Ball season is upon us. Children ages 4-14 can join for a season filled with fun, teamwork, and skill-building. Please fill out a form and have it turned in by Friday February 13th. Registration is $50 per child with a $100 cap per family. Payment is due at time of registration. Cash or check made payable to Prairie Home Rec Association will be accepted.
